blocks.text:
## Route highlights

In Guatemala, enjoy a walking tour of Antigua, the Pacaya volcanic complex, the Tz’utujil Maya towns on Lake Atitlán and the highland market of Chichicastenango. The route then continues through Tikal, Río Dulce and Livingston to Copán in Honduras.

In El Salvador, the group explores the historic centre of San Salvador and the archaeological sites of San Andrés and Joya de Cerén. Nicaragua continues the theme of volcanoes and colonial cities: León, Managua, Masaya and Granada. In Costa Rica, the itinerary includes the Pacific coast, Monteverde, Arenal, Caño Negro, Poás and La Paz Waterfall Gardens.

Notable stops along the route include San Juan on Lake Atitlán, Santiago Atitlán, Río Dulce, one of Guatemala’s most scenic rivers, and Costa Rica’s natural areas.
